By the Zarla design team · Updated October 2026

Looking for electrician website design ideas? These 12 examples are the best we could find — residential, 24-hour and commercial electricians, plus six designs you can build with Zarla — and each comes with a breakdown of the specific design move that wins the call. ## What every electrician website design needs

Look at the electrician sites that win the call and the page runs in the same order, top to bottom: a header with your number as a tap-to-call button and a plain note on emergency and after-hours work; a first screen with the trade and the town in the headline, one quote or booking button, and a strip of proof right under it (licensed, insured, your Google rating, years in business); your services grouped by the job a homeowner has (panel upgrades, EV chargers, lighting, rewiring, generators, troubleshooting), each with its own page; real photos of your vans and your finished work, not a stock lightning bolt; reviews; the towns you cover; financing beside the big-ticket jobs if you offer it; and a quote form to close. Each example below calls out the choice worth stealing for your own electrician website.

dyadelectrical.com.au

![Dyad Air & Electrical website — Air + Electrical design example](/_next/image?url=%2Finspiration%2Fdyad-electrical.jpg&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_DmcvkNxQAsxVKgT7NYWueUHpSWAy)

Real site · Brisbane, AU

01

*   Air + Electrical
*   Premium
*   Charcoal + lime

### Dyad Air & Electrical: Condensed type, thirty-year numeral

Dyad Air & Electrical is the most designed electrician site in this set: a moody night storefront photo, a tiny overline naming the patch ('Strathpine / North Brisbane'), then 'AIR & ELECTRICAL SERVICES' in towering condensed capitals with a single lime CTA — and a giant '30+ YEARS' numeral anchoring the corner like a monument. The dark-plus-lime system carries into 'Brisbane's Favourite Electricians,' where the real conversion asset sits: three review platforms in a row — Google 5.0, hipages 5.0, Facebook 5.0 — triangulating the same verdict. One platform can be cherry-picked; three agreeing is statistics. Premium type discipline on a trades site reads as operational discipline, and that's what commercial clients are actually vetting.

*   Giant condensed caps + lime on dark — premium trade type
*   Three review platforms agreeing beats one perfect score
*   '30+ years' as a monument numeral, not a sentence

_Steal this:_ Show 5.0 on three platforms side by side. One rating is a claim; three agreeing is evidence.

![Bright Electrical website — Residential Sparkie design example](/_next/image?url=%2Finspiration%2Fbright-electrical.jpg&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_DmcvkNxQAsxVKgT7NYWueUHpSWAy)

Real site · Perth, AU

02

*   Residential Sparkie
*   Trustworthy
*   Navy + orange

### Bright Electrical: A trust strip before the scroll

Bright Electrical runs the conventional playbook at its cleanest: 'Trusted Perth Electricians' over a dusk-lit suburban home, an orange Get a Free Quote button, and — the detail worth copying — a five-item trust strip pinned directly under the navigation: Satisfaction Guarantee, Premium Suppliers, Local Family Owned, Fully Licensed & Insured, Residential & Commercial. Every claim a homeowner needs to feel safe, resolved before the first scroll. Below, four service cards (Residential, Commercial, EV Chargers, Energy Solutions) with real photography split the audience, and putting EV chargers on equal footing signals a trade keeping pace with 2026 demand rather than rewiring like it's 2005. Solid, calm, complete — competence as a design language.

*   Five-claim trust strip settles safety before the scroll
*   EV chargers as a first-class service signals currency
*   Dusk home photo warms a licence-and-insurance trade

_Steal this:_ Pin your licence, insurance and guarantee in a strip under the nav — answer the safety question before it's asked.

[Visit Bright Electrical](https://brightelectricalperth.com.au/)Build a site like this

![Marlec Electrical website — 24/7 Electricians design example](/_next/image?url=%2Finspiration%2Fmarlec-electrical.jpg&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_DmcvkNxQAsxVKgT7NYWueUHpSWAy)

Real site · Melbourne, AU

03

*   24/7 Electricians
*   Bold
*   Charcoal + lime

### Marlec Electrical: The wordmark ghosted at billboard scale

Marlec Electrical floats its own name — 'MARLEC ELECTRICAL' in huge ghosted letterspacing — across a photo of the founders with their van, with '24 Hour Melbourne Electricians' beneath and a lime contact button. The ghost-wordmark move turns a small brothers-founded business into something that reads like an established brand, and the van photo keeps it honest. Underneath, a Google 5.0 badge and then the three-pillar row that does the persuading: 24/7 availability, Master Electricians accreditation, and Lifetime Workmanship Guaranteed. A lifetime guarantee is the boldest promise an electrician can print, and giving it equal billing with certification tells customers exactly how the business expects to be judged: on the work, forever.

*   Ghosted billboard wordmark makes a small firm read established
*   Founders-with-van photo keeps the scale claim honest
*   'Lifetime workmanship guaranteed' printed as a pillar

# Electrician Website Design (UK) — fast builds, real leads, no faff

If you wire homes for a living, you shouldn’t be wrestling with a clunky site that hides your number and buries your reviews. We build **electrician websites** that load quickly, look sharp on mobile, and turn “Got a minute to quote this fuseboard?” into an actual enquiry. Simple.

Domestic? Commercial? 24/7 call-outs? We’ll shape the site around what you sell and where you travel, so you’re visible for the jobs you want — not the tyre-kickers you don’t.

## Why choose Electrician Website Design

*   **Built for trades, not techies:** clear services, prices (if you want them), photos that prove you do tidy work, and calls-to-action that actually get tapped.
*   **Local SEO baked in:** service-area pages, _Google Business Profile_ optimisation advice, schema, reviews pulled through — the works.
*   **Speed first:** lean code, compressed images, Core Web Vitals in the green. Because slow = gone.
*   **Mobile-happy:** every layout checks out on phones (where most of your leads start).
*   **Content done for you:** we write the copy in your voice — NICEIC/NAPIT ready, no waffle.
*   **Forms that convert:** simple quote form, optional WhatsApp click-to-chat, emergency call buttons after hours.
*   **No mystery costs:** fixed-fee build, optional monthly care plan. Hosting and business email sorted if you need it.

### What your Electrician Website will include as standard

*   Home, Services (split by _Rewires, EV Charging, Consumer Units, EICRs_ etc.), About, Gallery/Projects, Areas We Cover, Contact.
*   Fast, accessible design; dark-on-light text; large tap targets; click-to-call on mobile.
*   On-page SEO: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, image alt text.
*   Structured data: Local Business + Service + FAQ schema for richer snippets.
*   Review widgets + trust marks (NICEIC, NAPIT, Trustmark, Checkatrade etc. — if applicable).
*   GDPR-compliant cookie banner, privacy and terms pages.

## How we build (typical 10–14 day turnaround)

1.  **Kick-off (Day 1):** 20-minute call. You tell us the jobs you want more of, towns you cover, and what makes you different. We map the site and keywords accordingly.
2.  **Content & assets (Days 1–3):** send your logo, colours, any photos. No pics? We can supply trade-safe stock while you gather your own.
3.  **Design preview (Days 3–5):** we build the home, one service page, and the contact flow. You sign off the look and tone.
4.  **Full build (Days 5–10):** remaining pages, local SEO structure, schema, speed passes, form + spam protection, analytics.
5.  **Snag & go-live (Days 10–14):** final tweaks, DNS/hosting, submit to Google, track calls and forms from day one.

_Need it yesterday?_ Tell us your deadline. If content is ready, we can compress the timeline.

## Electrician SEO that isn’t smoke and mirrors

Ranking for **“Electrician Website Design”** is our job; ranking _you_ for “electrician near me” in your patch is yours and ours together. Here’s what we actually do:

*   **Service-area pages** tuned to towns you really visit (not 50 random places). Each page gets unique copy, FAQs, and a recent job snippet.
*   **Schema everywhere:** LocalBusiness, Service, Review, and FAQ schema to help Google understand the business and show richer results.
*   **GBP tune-up:** categories, services, products, Q&A, review prompts, UTM tracking to measure what’s working.
*   **Review engine:** polite follow-up texts/emails to grow Google reviews (no incentives — just good timing and wording).
*   **Blog/playbook (optional):** short posts that target “how much is an EICR in \[Town\]”, “consumer unit replacement cost”, “EV charger grants” — the queries people actually type.
*   **Tracking:** call tracking numbers, form attribution, and a simple dashboard so you can see enquiries by page.

### What we don’t do

No gimmicks, no “rank #1 in a week” promises, no link-spam. We build solid sites, earn trust, and let the results stack month after month.

## Recent electrician website designs

Want to see the style before you jump? Ask for our live demo links — domestic specialists, commercial contractors, EV installers, landlord testing firms — we’ll send examples that match your niche and budget.

## Copywriting that sounds like a real sparky, not a robot

We write like you speak to customers: straight, friendly, no jargon unless you want it. If you’ve got WhatsApp voice notes or bullet-points, we’ll turn them into clean web copy and keep the regional flavour (Liverpool ≠ Leeds ≠ London — we get it).

## Integrations & nice-to-haves

*   Online quote form with photo upload (great for board swaps and EV chargers).
*   WhatsApp click-to-chat and smart after-hours “Call us 24/7” toggles.
*   Booking links if you use a diary app; invoice/pay links if you use Stripe/GoCardless.
*   Facebook/Instagram pixels for retargeting (optional).

## Hosting, email & support

Prefer not to touch servers? We’ll host, secure and update the site, manage backups, and keep an eye on uptime. Need a professional email? We’ll set that up too.

## FAQs (quick, honest answers)

### How quickly can you launch my electrician website?

Most builds go live in **10–14 days** once content is agreed. If everything’s ready up front, we can move faster.

### Do you handle the SEO?

Yes — on-page SEO is included. We sort titles, meta, headings, schema, internal links, and the local structure. We’ll also give you a tidy checklist for reviews and your Google Business Profile.

Absolutely. Over half your traffic will be mobile. We test layouts on common devices and keep buttons big, text legible, and the phone number front-and-centre.
